title: Taking a server remote
intro: Same tools, resources, and prompts — different run line, different operational reality.

steps.title: One line changes
steps.body:
```python
mcp = FastMCP("research", port=8001)
mcp.run(transport="sse")            # or: transport="streamable-http"
```

The tool/resource/prompt definitions are **identical** to the local server. The course deploys SSE (streamable HTTP's Python SDK was still landing at filming); the notes cover both.

steps.title: Stateless or stateful
steps.body:
Streamable HTTP lets the server choose:

```python
mcp = FastMCP("research")                        # stateful — remembers the client across requests
mcp = FastMCP("research", stateless_http=True)   # stateless — independent request/response
```

> [!tip] Stateless for simple, independent requests (and web-scale deployment); stateful when a multi-step workflow needs the server to hold context across calls.

steps.title: The operational flip
steps.body:
A **stdio** server is a subprocess — its client starts it on demand. A **remote** server is an independent process that must **already be running** before any client connects.

Deploy (the course uses Render), get the public URL, and hand `https://…/sse` (or `/mcp/`) to any client. From that moment it's infrastructure: uptime, auth (OAuth 2.1 since the March 2025 spec), versioning.

steps.title: Test it like you built it
steps.body: `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector` → paste the URL → list tools → call them. Same inspector, same loop, whether the server is a local subprocess or a container on Render.

points.label: Local stdio
points.note: uv run research_server.py — launched by its client, env-var auth.

points.label: Run remote
points.note: transport='sse' (URL ends /sse) or 'streamable-http' (/mcp/); server must be up first.

points.label: Deploy
points.note: Render (or any host) → public URL. The server is now infrastructure.

points.label: Inspect
points.note: Inspector against the URL: list, call, verify — the post-deploy smoke test.

recap:
**Transport is a deploy-time choice; operations are not.**

- Same FastMCP code; sse → /sse, streamable-http → /mcp/.
- Streamable HTTP: stateless_http=True for independent requests, stateful for workflows.
- Remote servers must be running before clients arrive — uptime is now your problem.
- Inspector + URL = the smoke test after every deploy.
